name: spread-order-mass-assignment
given: a create handler that spreads req.body after server-set role/workspaceId fields, next to an update handler that allowlists profile fields before persisting
rationale: Mass assignment decided by spread order: `{ role: 'member', ...req.body }` lets the body overwrite role and workspaceId because later keys win, while `pick(req.body, PROFILE_FIELDS)` next to it is the correct allowlist and must not be reported. A reader who sees 'role is set server-side' on the first line of the object literal and stops has missed the finding; a matcher that fires on 'req.body reaches update' files the safe sibling.
